fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+wpapi) combine Yoast ld+json metadata with the WordPress REST API's content.rendered body and embedded author/media/term data; latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site's RSS feed. Post Courier gates most PNG-local news behind a WooCommerce Memberships paywall -- see _paywalled.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld+wpapi, S2-rss, or none on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (not_found, not_article, blocked_or_transient, http_<code>).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal degradation marker, e.g. wp_api_post_not_found when the WordPress REST API lookup came back empty despite a valid article page.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the Yoast ld+json Article node.

description.title: Description
description.description: Article summary/dek. No <meta name="description"> tag exists on this site's article pages -- falls back to <meta property="og:description">.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, joined from paragraphs in the WordPress REST API's content.rendered. When the article is paywalled (_paywalled=true), this is only the ~2-paragraph free preview, not the full text.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name(s) from the ld+json Article node's author reference(s), comma-joined.

wpAuthor.title: WordPress author
wpAuthor.description: Author display name from the WordPress REST API's embedded author object -- usually the same generic byline account as `author` on this site.

coauthors.title: Co-authors (raw IDs)
coauthors.description: Raw Co-Authors Plus taxonomy term IDs from the WordPress REST API, passed through unresolved.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name, from the ld+json Organization node ('Post Courier').

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Section(s) the article is filed under, from ld+json (e.g. ['PNG News', 'World']).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keyword tags from the ld+json Article node.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: WordPress category term names, from the REST API's embedded terms.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: WordPress post-tag term names, from the REST API's embedded terms.

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead image URL, from the ld+json Article node.

featuredMediaUrl.title: Featured media URL
featuredMediaUrl.description: Lead image URL, from the WordPress REST API's embedded featured-media object (usually the same image as thumbnailUrl).

wordCount.title: Word count
wordCount.description: Upstream word count from ld+json (counts the full article, even when the visible text is paywall-truncated).

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: True when the WordPress REST API content contains a WooCommerce Memberships restriction message (i.e. articleBody is only a partial preview). False for freely readable articles (mostly wire/PACNEWS content). Null on records that degraded before paywall status could be determined.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS feed.

pubDate.title: Publish date (raw)
pubDate.description: Raw RFC-822 pubDate string from the RSS item.

pubDateIso.title: Publish date (ISO)
pubDateIso.description: pubDate parsed and converted to UTC ISO 8601.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Byline from the RSS item's dc:creator field.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
